claim_boundary: This supplementary analysis makes the experimental and simulated Haven conventions explicit and compares the reported single-crystal point with a configuration-level prediction for the reciprocal ratio. The 298 K prediction is a long extrapolation from 700-900 K, the experimental point has no reported uncertainty here, and compatibility is descriptive rather than proof of model validity.
preregistration_note: Frozen while the first formal 500 ps trajectory was incomplete and before any formal tracer, collective, or ratio estimate existed. The benchmark and reciprocal mapping were selected from the exact-composition single-crystal publication without inspecting simulation outcomes.

ratio_estimator.mapping: H_R = 1/(D_collective/D_tracer) for one monovalent mobile species when D_collective is the conductivity diffusion coefficient D_sigma
ratio_estimator.measurement_variance: sample variance of paired non-overlapping-block log(D_collective/D_tracer) divided by the number of valid paired blocks

ratio_temperature_model.interpretation_of_slope: difference between collective and tracer activation energies
ratio_temperature_model.configuration_fit: weighted least squares with conservative chi-square covariance scaling
ratio_temperature_model.population_fit: configuration bootstrap and REML summary; configuration is the inferential unit

decision_rules.analysis_completeness: All 25 tracer and collective points and at least four paired positive blocks per point are required; no cell may be dropped.
decision_rules.experimental_compatibility: Report whether H_R=0.4, equivalently D_collective/D_tracer=2.5, lies inside the 95% new-configuration predictive interval at 298 K.
decision_rules.incompatibility_action: Retain the incompatibility as a scientific result; it does not fail computational completeness.
decision_rules.terminology: Every ratio must be labelled by numerator and denominator; bare 'Haven ratio' is forbidden without its equation.
